title: Resend an UNKNOWN Engram turn outcome once, with the same idempotency key, before showing Waiting/Unknown
outcome: Turn-gate simplification Greg adopted 25 Sep (Engram::Opus relay, mailbox #200). On an UNKNOWN outcome (timeout or transport loss) TermAl resends the byte-identical request once, automatically, with the same idempotency key. Engram answers a repeated key with the decision it already made. Only a second UNKNOWN reaches the user as Waiting/Unknown with Resume. A real refusal still goes straight to the user, with no resend. Related: tm-8b7y (durable uncertain turn-begin on child cancel/fail). Acceptance: tests for one resend on timeout and one on transport loss, no resend after a refusal or a grant, the same key and body on the resend, and Waiting/Unknown after the second UNKNOWN.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 2, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DUP. Same-key automatic replay is criterion 2 of w-7224e6317e55.
